objective: Acquire verified customers for the live Foundry Express TypeScript Starter while preserving truthful attribution and zero upfront acquisition spend.

customer.primary: developers who want to start a small Express + TypeScript service without repeating baseline setup
jobs: start an Express TypeScript API quickly
avoid recreating strict TypeScript and scripts
begin with a health route and environment example

experiments.hypothesis: A problem-first landing page aimed at developers searching for an Express TypeScript starter can produce attributable checkout starts and purchases.
experiments.success_evidence: verified checkout starts and paid sessions attributed to the campaign
experiments.stop: no fabricated demand conclusions; revise only from observed evidence
